g.text: Runtime and LOC across eight shared problems
Benchmarks Game-style box plots | points retain individual problem outcomes
Both x2c columns use ordinary threads in six workloads; thresholds are program-specific.
Apple M4 Max | local inputs | 12-sample fresh x2c medians; foreign references pinned | run 20261101T161913Z
Boxes: middle 50% of problem ratios; centre line: median; whiskers: capped 1.5 IQR. Java includes JVM startup and JIT compilation. K-nucleotide and binary-trees are excluded.
